data.description: From the Result Validator report (2026-10-04), the small items that need no ruling, one commit each. Line numbers are from main @ 0a4b6fb; re-find each. (1) AC-71 wall clause (row 41): add the missing assertion that the wall receipt contains no sentence about the explanation (web/test, next to ok 241; the data already agrees). (2) Stale docs: web/home/measure.html:24 and room/README.md:240 name q7 as the widest question; q4 (5 x 78) is, since PR #36 (F-40). (3) The static fallback embeds the live wall's fetch of PUT /rooms/.../fit, dead in static mode and blocked by its CSP; strip or guard it in fallback.py so the file carries no request path. (4) The fallback's live region keeps The question is on the screen. after Esc returns to idle; clear it. (5) Three dormant [data-room=dim] rules ship (web/shared/components.css:116,141,142) though no dark mode exists (AC-80, DESIGN.md lights up); remove them or add the one-line comment that says why they stay, and add the absent-dark-mode assertion row 94 noted is missing. (6) The pencil provenance marker is aria-hidden on take-it-home but not on the host; align them. (7) Leftover HOST_DEV_TOKEN comments and empty values in .env.example:39-40, fly.toml and the justfile (all serialized shared files: ask the Orchestrator before touching any). (8) After PR #46 merges: migrate_mvp.py:561 lost the space after the equals sign (repo =Path); restore it. Ask, do not decide: JoinRefusal::NotYetOpen is never emitted because joins are accepted in idle; whether to emit it or delete the variant and its section 11 string is the client's. Acceptance: just test, just a11y, just canary green; nothing under bank/questions/ or the recordings. HELD: minted from the audit; released on the client's word.

data.body: ORCHESTRATOR 2026-10-04 21:2x — from PR #47's merge-scoped re-read at a796add (PQ-25), four cosmetic NITs for this ticket's next touch of the pipeline: (1) schedule.py ~:247-250, the _call docstring still says 'retried on connection failures and 5xx only' — now 5xx, 408 and 429; (2) schedule.py ~:500, 'is not a bank question (not in the bank)' says it twice — 'skipped: <id> is not in the bank'; (3) schedule.py ~:538-547 / fallback.py ~:294-302, 'were not written' overstates when the .html landed before the sheet on a full disk — wording only; (4) pipeline/README.md ~:67, a reflowed line far longer than its neighbours.

ORCHESTRATOR 2026-10-04 22:3x — small item from PQ-29's dispatch: room/README.md ~853–858 ('The trial org stops the machine', 'add a card at https://fly.io/trial') and the burst section's references to the trial window (~949, ~963) are stale — the client added a card during PQ-11 (2026-09-27, cap $10) and the v11 machine has run continuously since 2026-09-29. Rewrite the paragraph as the paid-org fact (spending cap; machines run until stopped) when this file is next touched.

ORCHESTRATOR 2026-10-04 22:4x — small item from PQ-29: schedule.py exposes a 'reserve' subcommand (count, trend, warning alone) with no justfile recipe; PQ-29 was cleared for exactly 'schedule' and 'sync'. Add 'reserve *ARGS' beside them on the next justfile touch, and name it in docs/RUNBOOK.md's reserve paragraph.

ORCHESTRATOR 2026-10-04 23:3x — two cosmetic NITs from PR #48's merge-scoped re-read, for the next touch of docs/RUNBOOK.md: (1) :331 'lists every incorrect option' — 'incorrect' is a SPEC 11 Forbidden-row word (organizer-facing here, not a Say line, so no test fires); say 'every other option'. (2) :176-177 anchors the five minutes 'Start to End Pop Quiz' while the 30 s idle wait sits before Start and AC-89 is end to end; drop the apposition or say 'from the join strip to End Pop Quiz'. Also: a 'reserve *ARGS' recipe (noted earlier) would let the runbook's reserve paragraph name 'just reserve'.

AUDIT from the guardrail audit (PQ-28, PR #49, docs/audit/2026-10-guardrail-audit.md, audit tree 0c7d60a): GAP-18 (G-9, NIT): HOST_DEV_TOKEN is left over in .env.example:39-40 and fly.toml. Item 7 here; sufficient.
From PR #49's merge-scoped re-read: docs/audit/2026-10-guardrail-audit.md:246 is one unwrapped long line. Cosmetic.

Final validation report addendum (row 98): Safari on macOS skips buttons on plain Tab by default (a platform setting). docs/RUNBOOK.md could tell a keyboard-only host to use Option+Tab. Docs-only, cosmetic.
